title: US Warships Reportedly Ready for Potential Strikes on Iran, Per WSJ
detail: The Wall Street Journal reportedly says US warships are positioned and ready for potential strikes on Iran, amid reports of US-Israeli planning for renewed action. Reported via aggregator; not independently confirmed.

title: Iran Says It Will Not Let US Warships Near the Gulf as Trump Weighs New Attacks
detail: Iran said US warships would not be allowed to approach the Gulf under any circumstances, warning it could hit US bases and ships and Gulf economic infrastructure. Trump said there would be no strike on the day, while reports (WSJ, FT) describe naval reinforcement and debate over timing of renewed strikes ahead of Israel's Oct 27 election and the US midterms. Not independently confirmed beyond reporting.

media.caption: Iran says it won't allow US warships to get close as Trump ponders new attacks
